function: Channel estimation for MIMO-OFDM: learned channel-to-channel mapping that refines LS-interpolated estimates in spatial-frequency-time and angle-delay-Doppler domains (p. 1-2).
system: Downlink MIMO-OFDM, BS with M antennas serving N single-antenna users; 8/8 Tx/Rx antennas, 72 subcarriers, 14 slots; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: 3D dual FSRCNN (spatial-frequency-time plus angle-delay-Doppler CNNs), supervised MSE with Adam; MAML meta-learning offline then online adaptation; alternative variant meta-trains only the ADD CNN (p. 2-4).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP TDL-D channel (TR 38.901) from MATLAB 5G Toolbox, 300 ns delay spread, 1 kHz Doppler, 72 subcarriers, 14 slots; no public dataset or measurement (p. 4-5).
test_conditions: Train SNR 10 dB, test 0-20 dB; online learning at 1 kHz Doppler, offline at 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 kHz; Fig. 4 tests 1-2.6 kHz (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: LS with interpolation, LMMSE. Learned: DualCNN [4], SRCNN [6], SRCNN with meta-learning [5], 3D CNN [7] (p. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR (Fig. 2), versus online-learning iterations (Fig. 3), and versus Doppler shift (Fig. 4); online-learning GFLOPs (p. 4-5).
complexity: 395.4 GFLOPs per online iteration; total online GFLOPs 27,678 (3D dual CNN), 19,770 (with ML), 3,954 (A-ML) (p. 5). No parameter count or inference cost.
q1_support: p. 4: "The TDL (Tapped delay-line) channel model used at system model is defined at [13]"; Table I: Channel model TDL-D; p. 5: reference [13] is 3GPP TR 38.901.
q2_support: p. 5: "online learning was performed using samples with a Doppler shift of 1 kHz"; Fig. 4 tests Doppler 1, 1.4, 2.2 and 2.6 kHz, so 1.4, 2.2 and 2.6 kHz were not used in training, after online adaptation.
q3_support: p. 4: "a comparison with LS with interpolation [5], LMMSE in (4), DualCNN [4], SRCNN [6] and SRCNN with meta-learning [5]", all in NMSE.
q4_support: p. 5: "with A-ML are about 27,678, 19,770, and 3,954 GFLOPs based on 395.4 GFLOPs per online iteration"
q5_support: p. 4: "The TDL (Tapped delay-line) channel model used at system model is defined at [13]"; channels are simulated with the MATLAB 5G Toolbox, and no code or data link or DOI appears in the paper.
notes: Eq. (2) on p. 2 is a path-based MIMO channel, but the simulations use TDL-D (Table I, p. 4), so q1 rests on TDL-D from 3GPP TR 38.901 (ref. [13], p. 5). Carrier frequency is never stated. The GFLOPs on p. 5 are the cost of online training, not of inference. Fig. 4 has four Doppler points (1, 1.4, 2.2, 2.6 kHz).
